A '''group''' of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were active during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], the pirates captured the cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Galactic Breeze]]'' with the help of an [[Unidentified XLT-014 labor droid|XLT-014 labor droid]] who was reprogrammed to cause the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] to bring the ''Galactic Breeze'' to the wrong location.
